text:
My father duerme. His semblante augusto
        figura a apacible heart;
        is ahora tan dulce…
        si there is algo in él of amargo, seré I.


        There is soledad in the hogar; is reza;
        and not there is noticias of the hijos today.
        My father is despierta, ausculta
        the huida to Egipto, the restañante adiós.


        Is ahora tan cerca;
        si there is algo in él of lejos, seré I.
        And my mother pasea allá in the huertos,
        saboreando a sabor already without sabor.
        Is ahora tan suave,
        tan ala, tan salida, tan love.


        There is soledad in the hogar without bulla,
        without noticias, without verde, without niñez.
        And si there is algo quebrado in this tarde,
        and that baja and that cruje,
        are dos viejos caminos blancos, curvos.
        For ellos va my heart to pie.

translation.title: The pasos lejanos
